slides.vo: Amino acids are useless until they fold.

slides.title: The shape fits a receptor, like a key in a lock.

caption:
A chain of amino acids is useless until it folds 🧬 The shape is what fits a receptor, the way a key fits a lock. Heat or acid can unfold it permanently: same molecule, no activity left.
